items.quote: Ihre Entscheidung erbitten wir binnen 6 Werktagen ab Datum dieses Schreibens; als Werktage zählen dabei Montag bis Samstag, gesetzliche Feiertage nicht.
items.computation: Letter dated Friday 16.04.2027. Period is set 'ab Datum dieses Schreibens' (from the letter's date), so under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of the letter itself is not counted; counting starts 17.04.2027. Werktage are defined in the letter as Monday–Saturday excluding public holidays. Counting 6 such Werktage: Day 1 = Sat 17.04.2027; Sunday 18.04.2027 is excluded (not a Werktag); Day 2 = Mon 19.04.2027; Day 3 = Tue 20.04.2027; Day 4 = Wed 21.04.2027; Day 5 = Thu 22.04.2027; Day 6 = Fri 23.04.2027. No public holidays fall in this window (Easter Monday 2027 is 29.03.2027, already past; Labour Day 01.05.2027 is later). The 6th Werktag itself is a working day, so no further weekend/holiday shift under § 193 BGB is needed.
